statement: Decision records do not have a status field. Evolution occurs exclusively via version increment and supersedes reference. Once stored, decision records are absolutely immutable — no modification or deletion permitted.
rationale: Status-based lifecycle creates ambiguity about which decision is 'current' or 'valid'. Version-based evolution preserves complete history and prevents silent reinterpretation. Immutability ensures audit trail integrity.

constraints.statement: No status field shall exist in decision schema
Decision evolution must use version + supersedes mechanism only
Stored decisions must not be modified or deleted

invariants: Decision records are immutable after storage
Version history is always complete and traceable
No decision can be silently reinterpreted
